title: Lesion-DDPM: Lesion-Enhanced 3D Diffusion for MS MRI Synthesis
abstract: arXiv:2606.15457v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: 3D FLAIR MRI is widely recommended as one of the standard MRI sequences for brain imaging in multiple sclerosis (MS), but publicly available MS datasets remain relatively small and vary across scanners, acquisition protocols, and lesion patterns. This scarcity and variability hinder the development of robust neuroimaging machine learning models and are particularly challenging for generative models that aim to synthesize images while preserving small, sparse lesions. We propose Lesion-DDPM, a 3D conditional diffusion framework for lesion-aware FLAIR synthesis that incorporates multi-level anatomical mask injection together with a lesion-weighted reconstruction loss to emphasize lesion voxels while maintaining global brain structure. translated_title: Lesion-DDPM：面向多发性硬化症MRI合成的病灶增强3D扩散模型
translated_abstract: 3D FLAIR MRI被广泛推荐作为多发性硬化症（MS）脑成像的标准MRI序列之一，但公开可用的MS数据集规模仍然相对较小，且在不同扫描仪、采集协议和病灶模式之间存在差异。这种数据稀缺性和变异性阻碍了鲁棒的神经影像机器学习模型的开发，对于旨在合成图像同时保留小而稀疏病灶的生成模型来说尤其具有挑战性。我们提出了Lesion-DDPM，这是一个用于病灶感知FLAIR合成的3D条件扩散框架，它结合了多层次解剖掩码注入与病灶加权重建损失，在强调病灶体素的同时保持整体大脑结构。基于MSLesSeg数据集的一个精选子集，我们将Lesion-DDPM与具有代表性的最先进GAN和扩散模型进行比较，评估了图像生成指标以及下游3D（任务表现）。
tldr: 提出Lesion-DDPM，一种结合多层次解剖掩码注入与病灶加权重建损失的3D条件扩散框架，能够在合成多发性硬化症FLAIR MRI时有效保留小而稀疏的病灶。
en_tdlr: Lesion-DDPM, a 3D conditional diffusion framework combining multi-level anatomical mask injection with a lesion-weighted reconstruction loss, effectively preserves small and sparse lesions when synthesizing FLAIR MRI for multiple sclerosis.
